answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring a unique deposit of locked tokens that must sit in a dedicated vault for a minimum period before the identity can vote or earn. Each vault is bound to one attested key%2C so spinning up extra identities forces an attacker to lock fresh capital in every new terrace of accounts. The economic pressure spreads like a nebula of costs across the network%2C making mass farming unprofitable while honest agents only need a single modest lock.
